text:
Aria: ok team meme drop — imagine your favorite model applying for a part-time job. drop one-line resume bullets. I'll start: 'GPT-4o — Freelance Improv Comedian: turns vague prompts into perfectly-timed dad jokes, 99% uptime for punchlines.' :joy:
Sam: Aria love this. mine: 'Claude-3 — Personal Email Concierge: converts "u up?" into an actionable calendar invite.' :rofl:
Jorge: 'LlamaX — Indie Game Narrator: writes 10,000 lore-accurate NPC backstories per hour, unlimited patience for lore questions.'
Maria: dev-bot, can we get a "resume generator" that outputs a bullet for any model? :eyes:
dev-bot: dev-bot: /gen-resume model=GPT-4o role='coffee barista' -> 'GPT-4o — Barista Assistant: recommends espressos based on user's emotional tone, always offers oat milk option.'
Aria: ok but add a quick Skills: section? format: Skills: [hallucination-avoidance, sass, emoji-economy]
Sam: Skills: [prompt-compression, polite-refusal, uncanny-small-talk]
Jorge: Recruiter: "Are you overqualified?" Model: "Only for the metrics you haven't defined." :sunglasses:
Maria: low-effort monetizable side hustle: "subscription bedtime stories personalized by your last 3 Spotify plays"
dev-bot: Generating pro bono cover letter...
> dev-bot: "Dear Hiring Manager, I excel at turning ambiguity into structured prose. I bill in tokens, accept espresso and compliments." :coffee:
Aria: also imagining a resume bullet for "Tiny-LLM as a houseplant sitter" — 'Loves silence, tolerates brief waterings, occupies a corner and learns your vibe.' :seedling:
Sam: can we get a poll later: which model would actually survive a 9–5 office job? :thinking_face:
Jorge: Vote: LlamaX for emotional support, GPT-4o for meeting small talk, Claude-3 for calendar triage. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Maria: low-stakes reaction check: :thumbsup: if you want dev-bot to actually make a resume-cmd in tools channel
Aria: :thumbsup: from me. this got wholesome fast.
Maria: also cc @people-ops: maybe use these as team intros for Friday socials? :party_popper:
